caption: The drawing shows a single figure of a young girl standing, depicted in a frontal pose against a plain, light-colored background. She is wearing a long, brown skirt that reaches to her feet, a brown top, and a light-colored, possibly white or cream, shawl with blue fringes draped over her shoulders and fastened at the front. The girl also has a light bonnet with a dark, possibly black, edging, tied under her chin with a dark bow. Her hair is blonde and parted in the middle, peeking out under the bonnet. Her facial features are drawn with a light complexion, large eyes, a small mouth, and subtle blush on her cheeks. On the left side of her skirt (viewer's right), there is a visible pocket in a matching shade of grey-blue. The image is centered, leaving ample blank space around the figure. Below the drawing, the name "Jacob Gielens" is written in small letters.
title: Quaker Doll
